summary: Batch teardown of a counted array. Iterates i over the count stored at this+0x0, calling IndirectCallViaFunctionPointer(lpMem, i) per element, then frees the sub-resource at this+0x14 via sub_58AA6F and finally frees the array itself, returning sub_58AA6F's result.

local_names.lpMem: array container whose first dword is the element count
local_names.i: loop counter over the element count

operations.description: Loop from i=0 while i < count (dword at this+0x0), stepping by 1
Per-element callback: IndirectCallViaFunctionPointer(lpMem, i) invoked for each element
Frees the sub-resource pointer at this+0x14 (lpMem[5]) via sub_58AA6F
Frees the array container itself via sub_58AA6F(lpMem) and returns that routine's result

unresolved: IndirectCallViaFunctionPointer's per-element action (element destructor vs release callback) is not established from this packet alone
sub_58AA6F is treated as a memory deallocation routine from prior analysis (DERIVED); this packet only shows it is called on the sub-resource and the container
The owning class of the counted array container is unknown; the +0x0 count / +0x14 sub-resource layout is read-only evidence
